name: Songblade Search

angles.text: Dwarven expedition crews and archaeological digs are common across Khaz Modan, but venturing beyond the safety of Loch Modan into the dangerous Wetlands often carries severe risks for kin.
Alliance travelers venturing between Loch Modan and Menethil Harbor often pass through the excavation sites, lending aid to stranded dwarven prospectors and artisans.

faq.answer: Dorin Songblade gives the quest. He is an artisan currently overwhelmed with work refitting a pile of girdles, which kept him from accompanying his brother on an archaeological dig.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Songblade Search?

faq.answer: Daewyn Songblade is Dorin Songblade's brother. He departed alongside an excavation crew out of Loch Modan bound for the untamed hills of the Wetlands, but failed to send word back as he typically does.
Daewyn is located at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands. He can be identified by his strong familial resemblance to Dorin and his firearm, which has 'DLS' carved into its wooden stock.

aliases: why did daewyn go to wetlands
why did the dwarfs go to wetlands
faq.answer: Daewyn joined a dwarven digging expedition out of Loch Modan seeking uncharted hills in the Wetlands to conduct an archaeological excavation.
faq.q: Why did Daewyn travel to the Wetlands?

faq.answer: The initials 'DLS' carved into the firearm stock belong to Daewyn Songblade, confirming the dwarf found at the excavation site is indeed Dorin's missing brother.
faq.q: What do the initials carved on the gun mean?

faq.answer: Dorin grew concerned because Daewyn usually writes back promptly after setting off on a journey. Having received no letters following the departure to the Wetlands, Dorin felt an uneasy premonition that something had gone wrong.
faq.q: Why was Dorin worried about his brother?

sections.body: Dorin Songblade remained behind at his workshop, inundated with orders to refit girdles, while his brother Daewyn joined a dwarven excavation crew setting out from Loch Modan. Daewyn ventured north into the rugged hills of the Wetlands, eager to explore virgin ground untouched by dwarven pickaxes. However, Daewyn customarily sends letters immediately after arriving, and his silence left Dorin deeply unsettled.
sections.title: A Brother's Unease

sections.body: Travelers journeying into the Wetlands can locate Daewyn Songblade among the diggers at Whelgar's Excavation Site. Resembling his brother Dorin closely, Daewyn carries a distinctive rifle marked with the initials 'DLS' carved into the wooden stock, proving that he safely reached the remote excavation camp in the marshlands.
sections.title: The Dig in the Wetlands

summary: Songblade Search is a dwarven errand in which Dorin Songblade asks travelers to check on his brother Daewyn in the Wetlands. Daewyn set off with an archaeological crew from Loch Modan to dig in unexplored hills, but his uncharacteristic silence left his brother fearing the worst.
